title: A magyar zászló és a nemzeti színek (The National Flag & Colors)
grammar: Heraldic Symbolism, Constitutional Metaphors & Solemn Hymnic Registers

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can describe the Hungarian flag and say what its colours traditionally mean.
I can say how the flag became official and why the flag with a hole is a symbol of 1956.
I can say that many people pin a cockade on their coat on 15 March.
I can use the words of this lesson about the flag and its colours.
